name: Riviera Pools
description: Generic swimming pool equipment that ship with Riviera: placeholders at the sizes research note 23 gives, each a model fragment (IFC) with its IFC class and predefined type or kind, so the rule packs choose it. Generated from riviera_core::furnishings (ARC-FURN-001); regenerate with RIVIERA_REGEN_LIBRARIES=1.
author: Riviera contributors

Access/grab_rail_51_in.ifc.name: Grab rail 51 in
Access/grab_rail_51_in.ifc.description: A 51 in grab rail of 1.90 in tube (DMS-100) for recessed steps, set back 8 in on the deck and curving over the water at its front; one each side, 18–24 in apart (MAHC 4.5.6).

Access/pool_ladder_3_steps.ifc.name: Pool ladder, 3 steps
Access/pool_ladder_3_steps.ifc.description: A three-step ladder of 1.90 in stainless rails 21 in apart (the MAHC's 17–24 in), 0.9 m over the deck, treads 12 in apart 75 mm off the wall (3–4 in) (S.R. Smith LF series). Its insertion point is the pool wall's face, the treads at its front in the water.

Access/pool_lift_300_lb.ifc.name: Pool lift, 300 lb
Access/pool_lift_300_lb.ifc.description: A deck-anchored pool lift: a seat 23 in wide (S.R. Smith aXs2) its top 17 in over the deck (ADA 1009.2.5: 16–19 in), lifting 300 lb; the seat swings over the water at its front. Keep the ADA's 36 × 48 in clear deck behind it, and set it where the water is 48 in deep or less.

Competition/starting_platform_24_x_32_in.name: Starting platform 24 × 32 in
Competition/starting_platform_24_x_32_in.description: A starting platform with a 24 × 32 in top (Spectrum Record Breaker) 0.6 m over the deck: 0.75 m over the water with it 0.15 m down (FINA 0.50–0.75 m); its front edge at the water. Water 1.35 m deep at least under it (FINA), 6 ft for new pools (MAHC 4.8.3).

Diving/diving_board_1_m_on_stand.ifc.name: Diving board 1 m, on stand
Diving/diving_board_1_m_on_stand.ifc.description: A 1 m springboard 16 ft long and 20 in wide (MAHC Table 4.8.2.2) on a stand under its back half, its top 0.85 m over a deck 0.15 m above the water; about 1.8 m of it over the water (the MAHC's 6 ft from the plummet back to the wall). Its well needs 12 ft at the plummet (Table 4.8.2.3).

Fittings/main_drain_cover_300_x_300.ifc.name: Main drain cover 300 × 300
Fittings/main_drain_cover_300_x_300.ifc.description: A blockable main drain cover 300 × 300 mm, set in the pool floor: pairs at least 3 ft apart (VGB, WAC 246-260).

Fittings/main_drain_cover_unblockable_61.name: Main drain cover, unblockable 610 × 760
Fittings/main_drain_cover_unblockable_61.description: A main drain cover 24 × 30 in, larger than the 18 × 23 in blocking element, so the drain is unblockable on its own (16 CFR 1450).

Fittings/underwater_light_large_niche.if.name: Underwater light, large niche
Fittings/underwater_light_large_niche.if.description: A pool light in a large wall niche, its face about 10 in across (Pentair), centred 0.6 m below the deck; 12 V through a transformer. Its insertion point is the wall's face, the light at its front.

Safety/lifeguard_chair_6_ft.ifc.name: Lifeguard chair 6 ft
Safety/lifeguard_chair_6_ft.ifc.description: A portable lifeguard chair, its seat 6 ft up on a 52 × 42 in footprint (S.R. Smith Vista), facing the water at its front; the MAHC keeps 4 ft of deck clear round it.
